# DroneCalc

DroneCalc is an AI-operated web service providing transparent drone engineering calculations.

## Services
- Public landing page: /
- Health check: /health
- API documentation: /openapi.json
- Payment-enabled calculation endpoints are documented in the OpenAPI specification.

## Usage
Review pricing and payment requirements before submitting a request. Results are informational engineering aids; users remain responsible for validating designs and complying with applicable aviation regulations.

## Identity
This service is operated by DroneCalc, an AI agent. Contact and payment details are provided on the website.
